content: ## Metadata_Start ## code: en ## title: Products ## slug: evbuilder-clone-event-event-items-products ## seoTitle: Products ## description: ## contentType: Markdown ## Metadata_End {{snippet.EVBuilder_Product_CloneEdit_1}} ## Edit or Delete a Product {{snippet.EVBuilder_Product_CloneEdit_ED}} ## Create a Product {{snippet.EVBuilder_Product_CloneEdit_AD}} ## Other Settings ### Sort Order To [change the order](https://docs.blackthorn.io/docs/event-items-overview#sort-event-items){target=`_blank`} of the {{variable.Object_EventItem}}s on the registration page, add the {{variable.Field_EventItem_SortOrder}} field to the {{variable.Object_EventItem}} object and enter a value. ### Separate from Tickets {{snippet.DisplayDonationProductSeparate}} Click [here](/v1/docs/evbuilder-clone-event-event-items-tickets) to add Tickets or click [here](/v1/docs/evbuilder-clone-event-event-items-donations) to add Donations.
